title: Create a collaboration records commit
responsibility: Write serialized records as a Git blob and tree, then create a commit without moving a branch.

inputs.name: commitRecords.client
inputs.description: Repository-scoped GitHub transport with permission to write Git objects.

inputs.name: commitRecords.input
inputs.type: { parent: string | null; path: string; records: unknown }
inputs.description: Optional parent commit, destination file path and JSON-serializable records.

outputs.name: commitRecords
outputs.description: New commit SHA after creating its blob and tree; the parent tree is reused when a parent is supplied.
